title: Stanford violated its AI policy by turning a Hispanic student into a fake Black woman in ad

reports.title: Stanford Used A.I. to Swap Black Student for Hispanic Student in a Photo
Stanford R&DE Uses AI to Race Swap Students for Advertising
University confirms use of AI-edited photo amid controversy
Stanford violated its AI policy by turning a Hispanic student into a fake Black woman in ad

summary:
Stanford Residential and Dining Enterprises used artificial intelligence to alter student photos in its advertisements, changing students' races, slimming their bodies, and modifying faces. Student Billy Ramirez, class of 2027, saw an image a Stanford photographer had taken and realized he had been removed and replaced with an AI generated Black woman. Two other students next to him were made visibly thinner. Ramirez said he was baffled and upset, feeling silenced and erased because Stanford changed how he was represented without his agreement.

The incident was described as humorous, and it drew thousands of reactions on the social media platform Fizz. The Stanford Review reported that it will continue to monitor future advertising and actions from Stanford Residential and Dining Enterprises as the university learns to use generative AI.
